summary: Husband of Catarina Croce and father of Domenica Malvaso, of Dasà in Calabria; John's maternal 5th-great-grandfather.
bio: Nicola Malvaso was born about 1740 and lived at Dasà in Calabria, or possibly at nearby Acquaro. He married Catarina Croce, born about 1742, and was the father of Domenica Malvaso. He died at Dasà. The birth years of husband and wife are approximate. He is John's maternal 5th-great-grandfather.
openQuestions: Domenica Malvaso's 1848 death act would name him
